title: 5-AS customer-edge route lifecycle and SAV baseline
purpose: Compare source-validation behavior at a customer-facing provider ingress while exercising BGP convergence, route withdrawal and restoration, and peer-link failover.

address_plan.host_address: first usable address in each /28; added as /32 only to the specified test endpoint

service_delivery.route: V/r1 installs a host-only route via the V/r5 point-to-point link
service_delivery.route_scope: kernel route on V/r1 only; not exported by BGP
service_delivery.rationale: pD /28 remains originated by V/r1 as a blackhole route; the more-specific host route delivers test packets to the service endpoint

roles.P: regional provider and SAV test point
roles.S: single-homed customer of P; probe source
roles.V: customer of Q; service and test-prefix origin

intra_as_layout.route_reflector_next_hop_behavior: must be explicitly configured and verified

policy.export: customer-learned and locally originated routes may be exported to all; peer/provider-learned routes only to customers

pD.purpose: stable destination/service; remains advertised during pK events

pK.purpose: known BGP route but unauthorized when used as a source by S; withdrawn using a dedicated static protocol

traffic.continuous_failover_stream: low-rate sequence-numbered UDP to pD; rate and packet size frozen before execution
traffic.receiver_evidence: capture at V/r5; do not infer SAV action from missing replies alone

event_sequence.event: Establish all BGP sessions and converge
event_sequence.gate: all 50 sessions established; expected routes present in RIB/FIB; stable interval recorded

event_sequence.event: Run no-SAV, strict-uRPF, then loose-uRPF in the same frozen topology; verify the active SAV mode at each arm
event_sequence.gate: before and after every arm, the all-router BGP/FIB fingerprint equals the initial baseline; each probe's exact sequence set, bound source, receiver count, and SAV drop-counter delta match expectation

event_sequence.event: Withdraw only pK using its dedicated static protocol at V/r1 in the loose-uRPF arm
event_sequence.expected: after absence is confirmed in relevant RIB/FIB and SAV readback, pK probe drops; pD remains reachable
after propagation and rule readback, loose-uRPF permits pK again; pD remains reachable

event_sequence.event: While loose-uRPF is active, administratively disable and restore the P-Q peer link during a low-rate continuous pS-to-pD UDP stream
event_sequence.expected: route to pD moves via R and returns via Q peer after restoration; pS remains authorized; record loss and each control/data-plane recovery timestamp

measurements: BGP session state and transition timestamps
Adj-RIB-In, Loc-RIB, and FIB route before/after each event
SAV rule generation, installation, and readback timestamps
per-packet source truth, ingress interface, decision, exact sequence set, SAV counter delta, and receiver capture
route convergence, rule convergence, packet-loss window, and service recovery as separate intervals

acceptance.control_plane: all 50 BGP sessions established; expected routes and selected paths match the frozen topology; a common stable interval of at least 3 seconds is recorded
acceptance.sav_arm_isolation: the all-router BGP/FIB fingerprint before and after every SAV arm equals the initial fingerprint
acceptance.per_probe: each 10-packet probe matches the arm matrix for receiver count and drop-counter delta; packet records have unique in-range sequence IDs and the bound source address
acceptance.independent_audit: persist each received packet record and each full router BGP/FIB fingerprint so a separate verifier can recompute the checks without importing the runner
acceptance.route_lifecycle: pK withdrawal and restoration are confirmed in BGP/FIB and SAV-table readback before their respective probes
acceptance.peer_failover: the observed data path changes S-P-Q-V to S-P-R-Q-V on peer failure and returns after restoration; report all sent/received IDs and timestamps without imposing an unvalidated convergence SLA
acceptance.resource_safety: available memory remains at least 3 GiB and host Swap growth does not exceed 1 MiB; ownership-scoped cleanup leaves no run containers or temporary links

run_plan.initial_smoke: one 50-node deployment; run no-SAV, strict-uRPF, and loose-uRPF sequentially with explicit table removal between arms
run_plan.assertion_recheck: two completed runs on the same VM after hardening; r1 checked runtime assertions, r2 added full raw evidence and passed independent audit; neither is a confirmatory repeat
run_plan.recheck_unit: three further full teardowns and rebuilds after freezing the scenario, runner, and verifier; technical repetitions on the same host, not independent hardware replication
run_plan.randomization: fixed arm order for semantic smoke; freeze or seed arm order for later performance comparison
run_plan.thresholds: record raw results first; set performance acceptance thresholds only after platform capability and measurement resolution are established

implementation_gates: compiler can build the 10-router-per-AS route-reflector layout
customer/peer/provider policy and expected path assertions pass
prefix withdrawal/re-advertisement reaches route and SAV rule readback
peer-link failure injection and recovery are observable
raw packet and full control-plane evidence can be independently rechecked
limitations: Synthetic isolated IPv4 BGP regression, not an Internet-representative sample.
The multihoming calibration fixture is a separate test and not TS01 evidence.
Same-VM repetitions do not establish independent hardware replication, capacity or an application SLA.
